offers_products.reason: Water is delivered as part of regulated utility service, so it is not a separate product offering.

offers_services.reason: Provides regulated water, wastewater and recycled water utility services across Pinal, Pima and Maricopa Counties.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Serves households in growth communities around Phoenix and Tucson with water and wastewater utility service.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves commercial customers and developers, who pay for new connections and meters, plus recycled water for irrigation.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers pay ongoing monthly bills under regulated tariffs for water and wastewater utility service.

cyclical_demand.reason: Households and businesses need water and wastewater service regardless of the economy; rates are regulated by the Arizona Corporation Commission.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly utility bills for water and wastewater service.

people_delivered.reason: Service depends on pipes, treatment plants and network assets, not mainly on staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are residential households and small commercial users in Arizona communities, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates 39 water, wastewater and recycled water systems with pipes, treatment plants and meters needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Recycled water is sold mainly for outdoor irrigation; developers pay for connections and meters, but residential customers dominate.
